maddeler.e:
ائتمنا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَنَا (iʔtamanā) /iʔ.ta.ma.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اِئْتَمَنَّا (iʔtamannā) /iʔ.ta.man.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اِئْتَمِنَا (iʔtaminā) /iʔ.ta.mi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
